title: How do you take multi-angle photos of shoes?
description: 📷 Orbitvu guide to capturing shoes from multiple angles. Automation, templates, clipping and multi-channel export.
tool: Orbitvu Station software, a pair of shoes and adhesive tape
logistics: A member of your team and an Orbitvu photo studio
introText:
The use of a 360° turntable controlled by software automates product photography from several angles. 🔄

This system makes it possible to establish a production flow directly from The photo studio, controlled by Orbitvu Station software.💻

How to shoot shoes under multiple angles and reuse your camera settings, brightness, editing... automatically to optimize the following shots?👠

Discover all the steps of the multi-angle shooting process on shoes:

steps.title: Define your specifications
steps.content:
You can take a picture of a shoe or the pair. For this tutorial, we explain the steps to take photos of a pair of shoes from multiple angles.👠

Choose from which key angles to present your shoes:

Side view, ¾ front and rear, rear and top view.

Complete this series of photographs with one or more Close-ups (close-ups on various details of the shoe) . 🔍

Standardization : apply a consistent nomenclature for your files in order to facilitate their organization (ex.: Collection_bottes_25.png).

✨ Tip : Thanks to Orbitvu Station, save a profile of angles and settings for a specific type of shoe. That simplifies the following sessions.

steps.title: Get your shoes ready
steps.content:
Make sure your products are flawless before you start:

Clean the shoes using cotton gloves, polishing cloth, and dust remover spray.🧺

Padding the inside with fabric or paper to structure the shoe and avoid creases. This preparation Reduces time required in post-production.

✨tip : Use smart devices, such as those of Studio Alphashot XL, which are automatically removed in the clipping process.

steps.title: Position your shoes
steps.content:
📍 Place your shoes in the center of the photo studio turntable. Several references are available to assist you:

Use the positioning laserIntegrated t for precise alignment. Or the focal point of the studio turntable.

Activate the mode ”Phantom image“ to facilitate the exact reproduction of the placement for all your products.👻‍

✨Practical tip : Save an investment model in Orbitvu Station allows you to guarantee consistency and homogeneity for your entire collection.

‍

steps.title: Set up the camera and lighting
steps.content:
Choose an included value between 200 and 400 To set your ISOs, an aperture value between f/11 and f/14 for photos with no blurry areas. 📷

For speed, opt for a value more than 1/50 when you have, as here, several LED lighting sources. Adjust the intensity of the LED panels with the software Orbitvu Station for perfect lighting. 💡

Orbitvu studios like The Alphashot XL, allow individual light control for complex products, such as shiny leather shoes.

When you get the desired result, save them for reuse the same settings afterwards. 📂

steps.title: Program the angles to be captured
steps.content:
How do I program multi-angle photos of shoes?

From the software's 2D photo mode, choose the angles and the number of angles of your shoe that you want to photograph.💻

It is possible to Connect multiple cameras simultaneously with the software and program, for example, a top view for your series of multi-angle shoe photos.👠

The studio Alphashot XL And her Multi camera rig, which can accommodate Up to 5 cameras and be used simultaneously to capture multiple perspectives at once. 📷

The Alphashot XL studio and its multi-camera rig, which can accommodate up to 5 cameras and be used simultaneously to capture multiple perspectives at once.

steps.title: Start automated shooting
steps.content:
Press ”Capture everything“ in the software Orbitvu Station to start the session. Let's go! 🔄

The turntable automatically positions the shoes at the angles selected earlier.

The images are captured and optimized in real time, with automatic cropping thanks to the feature IQ Mask.

steps.title: Retouch and apply in bulk
steps.content:
Retouch colors, contrasts or even curves of a single one of your shoe photos. 🎨

Once the image is retouched, apply these edits to the rest of the photographs taken from other angles.
‍
🚨If you made a mistake, you can always go back to the original image at any time.

steps.title: Create your template
steps.content:
💼 Thanks to this automation, you standardize your product photography workflow, while guaranteeing constant quality throughout your catalog. It is a saving valuable time in post-production, particularly useful for demanding e-commerce platforms or multi-channel marketplaces.

📸 This packshot approach is ideal for fashion and shoe brands that want to produce visuals that are professional, consistent and ready for integration.
steps.structuredText: Feel free to save your settings as templates in order to reuse them with other similar products. This template will help you increase your productivity.

steps.title: Export for multi-channel use
steps.content:
Do you need to publish on multiple media? Save and export your photos in multiple formats simultaneously: JPEG, PNG, Tiff, Raw... 📤

Prepare files that are suitable for web, print, or social media campaigns.

Use the e-commerce plugins Orbitvu to upload images directly to your platforms like Shopify or PrestaShop.

🧠 Thanks to the standardization of visuals, you facilitate integration into your PIM/DAM systems, and improve the shopping experience on your sites and marketplaces (Shopify, Zalando, Amazon...).

✨ Extra tip : Activate the option to customize file names and use a barcode scanner for maximum time savings.

faqs.question: Is multi-angle shooting time consuming?
faqs.answer: No, thanks to the automated turntable and the saved settings, each series of photos is taken in just a few minutes, without the need for manual repositioning.

faqs.question: What is the advantage of using an automated turntable rather than manual shooting?
faqs.answer: Automation ensures perfect alignment of products, increased speed and consistency of visuals, which is essential for a brand that wants professional and standardized results.

faqs.question: Does the system work with a single camera or multiple cameras?
faqs.answer: It can work with a single camera, but the Alphashot XL also allows you to connect up to 5 cameras simultaneously to capture multiple angles in a single shot.

faqs.question: Can these images be directly integrated into an e-commerce site?
faqs.answer: Yes, Orbitvu Station offers multi-format exports and e-commerce plugins that allow images to be uploaded directly to platforms such as Shopify or PrestaShop.

faqs.question: How to optimize the time savings in image processing?
faqs.answer: With batch editing features, a single edit can be automatically applied to all images in a single session, eliminating the need for individual edits.
